hooks: ANEMOS cowl neck mini dress: $345 down to $65. Ends tonight.
Hiperson leather knee boots, $324 to $162, in 15 of 16 sizes.
Daze City Straight jeans are $41 tonight, all 11 sizes.

brands.verdict: Three boots at exactly 50% off with nearly full size runs, 5 to 12; return terms weren't listed.
brands.say: Hiperson knee boot, $162 from $324, leather with a kitten heel.

items.why: Super tall leather boot with a kitten heel and a sheen finish, half off.
items.for_who: People who want a tall boot, low heel
items.skip_if: You want matte leather; this one has sheen.

items.why: Suede knee boot with a low heel and inside zip, $145, all 16 options in stock.
items.for_who: Chocolate or black suede, sizes 5 to 12
items.skip_if: You don't want to look after suede.

items.why: Leather ankle boot with what the brand calls a wearable heel, $134 from $268.
items.for_who: Someone who needs one black ankle boot
items.skip_if: You want cognac in an 11; it's gone.

brands.verdict: Sale colours run 50 to 60% off, deeper than the 25% sitewide headline, but they're final sale.
brands.say: Alma bag in black gloss, $168 from $358, a domed everyday bag.

items.why: Softly structured dome shape with rolled handles and metal feet, $190 off.
items.for_who: Someone who wants one everyday handbag
items.skip_if: You need the material spelled out; the listing doesn't.

items.why: Small barrel bag at 60% off, $108, sized for essentials only.
items.for_who: Phone, keys and cards people
items.skip_if: You carry more than the essentials.

items.why: Zipped tote with four large pockets and a key leash, $198 from $398.
items.for_who: Commuters who want a tote that zips
items.skip_if: You're unsure on the colour; final sale.

brands.verdict: All three are $41.30 from $118, which is 65% off, final sale, mostly in light washes.
brands.say: City high rise straight, $41 from $118, all 11 sizes in stock.

items.why: High rise straight leg with dark panels on a light wash, 99% cotton, every size.
items.for_who: Two-tone denim fans, sizes 23 to 33
items.skip_if: You want a plain single wash.

items.why: Pull-on wide leg with a drawstring waist and raw hem, in a light wash.
items.for_who: People who'd rather skip a button waistband
items.skip_if: You're a size 30; that one is gone.

items.why: Mid rise wide leg in light blue rigid cotton, also with a drawstring, 32 inch inseam.
items.for_who: Wide leg wearers who like rigid denim
items.skip_if: You're a 30 or 33; both sold out.

brands.verdict: The deepest markdown I found, 81% off the mini dress, but final sale with gaps in sizing.
brands.say: Cowl neck mini dress, $65 from $345, made in Los Angeles.

items.why: Lyocell stretch jersey made in Los Angeles; the neckline can go off the shoulder; $65.
items.for_who: Black XS to L, Cypress S to XL
items.skip_if: You're black XL or Cypress XS; final sale.

items.why: Off-the-shoulder A-line maxi in the same jersey, machine washable, $165 from $365.
items.for_who: Someone with a formal event coming up
items.skip_if: You want Cypress or rose; few sizes left.

items.why: Pleated wide leg in stretch twill with a side zip, 70% off at $120.
items.for_who: Black M, L or XXL; white has more
items.skip_if: You need a small; sold out in both.

brands.verdict: Half off the trench, about 40% off the coat and the cashmere, and all 5 sizes in stock on each.
brands.say: Hayes denim trench, $114 from $228, every size, final sale.

items.why: Medium wash denim trench at half off, XS to XL in stock, tagged final sale.
items.for_who: Someone who wants a denim coat
items.skip_if: You might return it; it's final sale.

items.why: Wool peacoat in a warm plaid, $100 off, all five sizes in stock.
items.for_who: Plaid coat people, XS to XL
items.skip_if: You need fabric percentages; the listing gave none.

items.why: Cashmere sweater in lilac for $138 from $238, all five sizes.
items.for_who: Anyone who'd actually wear lilac
items.skip_if: You don't wear lilac.

brands.verdict: Sunglasses and earrings are a true 60% off; the watch is 30%, and everything is final sale.
brands.say: Vittoria sunglasses, $80 from $200, oversized brown aviators with a pouch.

items.why: Oversized brown acetate aviators with tinted brown lenses, pouch and cloth included, $80.
items.for_who: Aviator wearers who like a big frame
items.skip_if: You can't try them on; final sale.

items.why: Clip-ons, so no piercing needed, in gold, silver or gold and black, $52.
items.for_who: Anyone without pierced ears
items.skip_if: Clip-ons bother your ears.

items.why: Leather strap, quartz movement, gold or silver plated steel dial, $196 from $280.
items.for_who: A gift for someone who wears watches
items.skip_if: You wanted 60% off; this is 30%.

brands.verdict: Sitewide is only 20% off; these three are 50 to 60% off, and the stones are cubic zirconia.
brands.say: Cecilia open ring, $84 from $208, sterling silver, sizes 5 to 10.

items.why: Two-band open ring, one side polished and one side CZ, 15 mm wide in total.
items.for_who: Chunky ring people, silver or gold plated
items.skip_if: You want a slim band; this is 15 mm.

items.why: Paperclip chain with a row of 2.5 mm CZs, adjustable 16 to 18 inches, $159.
items.for_who: Someone who wants the tennis necklace look
items.skip_if: You expect diamonds at $159; final sale.

items.why: 8.5 mm ribbed band in sterling silver or gold plate, $94 from $224.
items.for_who: Ring sizes 6 to 9 only
items.skip_if: You want gold in an 8; sold out.
